offering_description.value: Operates supermarkets in the southeastern United States that sell groceries, fresh foods, pharmacy products and general merchandise to households. Earns revenue from in-store and fuel center sales made directly to shoppers at its own locations.

primary_products.value: groceries; fresh produce; meat and seafood; prepared foods; general merchandise; fuel

primary_services.value: pharmacy services; online order pickup and delivery

items.detail: households shopping for groceries, pharmacy items and fuel
groceries, general merchandise and fuel sold to shoppers
prescription payments from insurers and pharmacy benefit programs
buys food and goods from suppliers and sells them to households through its stores

geography_served.detail: Southeastern states, including North Carolina, South Carolina, Georgia, Tennessee and Virginia

specialization.detail: single line of supermarkets with in-store pharmacies and fuel centers

items.detail: online ordering for pickup and delivery

regulatory_exposure.detail: medium: food safety rules, pharmacy licensing and alcohol sales rules from state and federal regulators

notes: Exact states and store count are from general knowledge and may be out of date.
